text:
ash: heads up — seeing ~2x spike in Tempo ingest over last hour, traces queuing up and tail latency >2s for trace retrieval. any ideas?
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: tempo-ingest-queue length > 1200 (p95 enqueue latency 1.3s)
kyle: Oof. Are these from a few noisy orgs or widespread? Can you paste top orgs by rate?
ash: top is org-42 and org-99 — org-42 is 3x normal. lots of low-value spans from batch jobs.
maria: we should enforce per-token quotas + server-side tail sampling. We already have per-customer QPS in Dedicated but not for hosted Tempo.
sam: what's the rollback/fallback plan? fallback to Datadog traces ingestion for high-priority customers? :thinking_face: 
lee: we can route by header `x-rd-priority` and maintain a small reserved lane for high-priority traces. low priority gets aggressive sampling or TTL=7d instead of 30d.
kyle: config idea:
```yaml
exporters:
  tempo_default: {}
  datadog_fallback: {}
processors:
  route_by_priority:
    match:
      - header: x-rd-priority
        value: high
        exporter: tempo_default
      - else:
        exporter: datadog_fallback
        sampling: tail
```
maria: care: sending to Datadog increases egress/cost and duplicates traces for customers who expect them in our Console. Need opt-in per-customer and audit log.
ash: agreed. maybe default: keep in Tempo but apply `span.truncation=true` + drop certain instrumentation spans (sql/metrics clients).
sam: UX question — how do we expose this in Console? customers need a simple toggle: 'priority routing' + sampling slider. Can we show expected QPS and cost delta?
lee: yes, Redwood Console can show projected tokens/egress with a simulated sample on a small trace set. Should be available in rollout page for Dedicated->Private.
kyle: also need observability: add per-exporter meter (queued, dropped, sample_rate) and per-org counters. Dashboard: eng-platform/traces/ingest-health.
maria: TL;DR: plan: (1) quick throttles + per-org qps; (2) add reserved high-priority lane; (3) fallthrough to Datadog only for opt-in enterprise; (4) Console toggles + cost estimates; (5) telemetry metrics + alerts.
ash: timeline? can we get (1) and (2) as emergency patch today and start (3)-(4) next week?
kyle: I can ship throttles and per-org counters today, need help from infra to wire reserved lane.
lee: I'll open infra ticket for reserved lanes and Datadog contract check.
infra-bot: Created ticket #INFR-4477 for tempo reserved lanes and #BILL-993 for egress cost review
sam: +1. also let's add a regression test to ensure no data loss for priority orgs during overload.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft the Console UX copy and mockup.
ash: thanks all — keep updates in this thread. tagging @maria @kyle @lee
